question: A million seconds is about 11.6 days. How many years is a billion seconds?
answer: About 31.7 years: a thousand times 11.6 days.
move: Turn big numbers into time before comparing them.
ask: When I hear millions and billions in the news, do I picture the gap, or just the words?
trap: Guessing about a year, since billion sounds like million plus a bit.
hint: Work out how many seconds there are in a year first.
steps: About 31.7 years: a thousand times 11.6 days.
reference: Paulos, Innumeracy: Mathematical Illiteracy and Its Consequences, Hill and Wang, 1988
